| Difficulty = 2
}}

{{recipe}}

== Ingredients ==
*1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Chickpea Flour|gram flour]] (''besan'')
*2–3 cups [[Cookbook:Ghee|ghee]], melted
*2 ½ cups [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
*¼ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] ground [[Cookbook:Cardamom|cardamom]] (''elachi'')
*Water

== Procedure ==
# Roast the gram flour in a small amount of ghee.
# Combine the sugar, cardamom, and a splash of water in a [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]]. [[Cookbook:Boiling|Boil]] it until the syrup reaches the [[Cookbook:Cooking Sugar#Thread Test|single thread stage]]. If more than one thread can be drawn, then more water needs to be added.
# Mix half the roasted gram flour into the hot sugar syrup, keeping the heat on.
# Gradually stir half the ghee into the gram flour mixture. Keep stirring the mixture until the ghee is absorbed.
# Repeat with the remaining gram flour and ghee. More ghee can be added just until the mixture stops taking in more ghee.
# After the mixture is boiled, it turns into crispy, bubble form. Pour it in a pan, and let cool. 
# Cut it into pieces of desired shapes.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* '''Milk Mysore pak''': chickpea flour is replaced by skimmed milk powder
